# Modal

Dialog for a short task that needs the user's full attention (create, edit, confirm). Lay out the content with
Stack / Section. Confirm irreversible actions with useConfirmDanger; reversible actions run directly and offer
undo instead of asking for confirmation.

**Interaction**: when it opens, focus moves into the dialog and `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` cycle inside it; `Esc`
closes it, and focus returns to the element that was focused before opening.

**Category**: Feedback · **Common uses**: Create and edit forms, confirmations, command palettes

## Import

```ts
import { Modal } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Put forms for creating and editing in a dialog; set `confirmLoading` on the confirm button while submitting.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  return (
    <>
      <Button variant="primary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        New project
      </Button>
      <Modal
        title="New project"
        open={open}
        okText="Create"
        onOk={() => setOpen(false)}
        onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
        destroyOnHidden
      >
        <Form layout="vertical">
          <Form.Item label="Project name" name="title" rules={[{ required: true }]}>
            <Input autoFocus />
          </Form.Item>
        </Form>
      </Modal>
    </>
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Flush content

`flush` removes the padding of the dialog so that the content lays itself out and fits the rounded corners, like
the search box and result list of a command palette.

```tsx
export function Flush() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
  return (
    <>
      <Button onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>Open command palette</Button>
      <Modal
        open={open}
        flush
        title={null}
        footer={null}
        closable={false}
        onCancel={() => setOpen(false)}
      >
        <Input size="lg" variant="borderless" placeholder="Search pages and commands" autoFocus />
        <Stack padding={4}>
          <Text tone="secondary">The result list is shown flush</Text>
        </Stack>
      </Modal>
    </>
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `flush` | `boolean` | Flush content: removes the padding of the dialog, so the content lays itself out and follows the rounded corners (such as the search field and result list of a command palette). Usually combined with `title={null}`, `footer={null}` and `closable={false}`. | — | No |

Also accepts the props of the corresponding Ant Design component (`ModalProps`), except `style` and `className`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
